candidate_source: candidate-a (scripts/build_official_evaluation_split.py, seed=42, groups=data/evaluation/sentiment_groups_v2_adapted.csv derived from corrected sentiment_groups_v2.csv)

quality_gate.rule: exact_leakage_count==0 and group_crossing_count==0 and unresolved_conflict_count==0 and min_class_support>=5 and previous_test_exposure_count==0

note: Supersedes the historical 0.5816 reference, which was computed on a 120-row hard-case-biased split that no longer exists on disk (overwritten during Fase Q2's export re-run, never git-tracked). This official test set is built from the full clean label pool (1888 manual labels minus 19 true label conflicts and prior-exposure rows), using corrected v2 grouping (scripts/build_sentiment_groups.py) that fixes a v1 grouping bug where same-text-different-target-entity rows (e.g. multi-issuer recommendation articles) were incorrectly flagged as label conflicts (241/253 of v1's flagged conflicts were this false-positive pattern, per reports/mixed_label_group_root_cause_summary.json). The true positive-class weakness documented in earlier phases (F1 0.377 on the old 120-row hard-case test) reflected performance on a deliberately hard/ambiguous subset, not the model's real-world performance -- on this representative, deduplicated, conflict-free test, positive F1 is 0.7209.
